t: 南京不战而降，向朱棣投降，靖难之役结束。建文帝失踪，他的家人被监禁。

dz: 南京不战而降，向朱棣投降，靖难之役结束。建文帝失踪，他的家人被监禁。
de: Nanjing surrenders to Zhu Di without a fight, ending the Jingnan campaign. The Jianwen Emperor disappears and his family is incarcerated.

t: 朱迪以"永乐皇帝"为时代名号而更出名,为中国明朝的王位.
te: Zhu Di, better known by his era name as the Yongle Emperor, assumes the throne over the Ming dynasty of China.
dz: 朱迪以"永乐皇帝"为时代名号而更出名,为中国明朝的王位.
de: Zhu Di, better known by his era name as the Yongle Emperor, assumes the throne over the Ming dynasty of China.

t: 安卡拉战役:蒂穆尔,蒂穆里德帝国的统治者,击败了奥斯曼帝国苏丹巴耶济德一世的部队.
te: Battle of Ankara: Timur, ruler of Timurid Empire, defeats forces of the Ottoman Empire sultan Bayezid I.
dz: 奥斯曼-蒂穆里德战争:安卡拉战役:蒂穆尔,蒂穆里德帝国的统治者,击败了奥斯曼帝国苏丹巴耶济德一世的部队.
de: Ottoman-Timurid Wars: Battle of Ankara: Timur, ruler of Timurid Empire, defeats forces of the Ottoman Empire sultan Bayezid I.

dz: 霍米尔登山战役(Battle of Homildon Hill):默多克·斯图尔特(英语:Murdoch Stewart, Duke of Albany and Archibald)手下的一支入侵苏格兰军队,厄尔·道格拉斯被一支由乔治,马克伯爵和亨利·珀西(英语:Henry Percy, 1st Earl of Northumberland)指挥的由500名英格兰弓箭手组成的分队所歼灭.
de: Battle of Homildon Hill: An invading Scottish army under Murdoch Stewart, Duke of Albany and Archibald, Earl Douglas is decimated by a contingent of 500 English archers under the command of George, Earl of March and Henry Percy, 1st Earl of Northumberland.
